<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1758202_demo.PDFGeneratorAjaxProcessor</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PDFGeneratorAjaxProcessor</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var PDFGeneratorAjaxProcessor = Class.create();
PDFGeneratorAjaxProcessor.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    
    generateAndDownloadPDF: function() {
        var response = {
            status: 'error',
            message: '',
            downloadUrl: ''
        };
        
        try {
            var tableName = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
            var sysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
            
            // 使用PDF生成工具类
            var pdfGenerator = new PDFGeneratorUtil();
            var result = pdfGenerator.generatePDF(tableName, sysId);
            
            if (result.status === 'success') {
                // 构建下载URL
                response.downloadUrl = '/sys_attachment.do?sys_id=' + result.attachmentSysId;
                response.status = 'success';
            } else {
                response.message = result.message;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            response.message = '服务器错误: ' + e.message;
            gs.error('PDFGeneratorAjaxProcessor错误: ' + e.message);
        }
        
        return JSON.stringify(response);
    }
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-05 06:29:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>981ab3f797b9e2101c50f91de053af4a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PDFGeneratorAjaxProcessor</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Demo" source="x_1758202_demo">f06f80349735ae501c50f91de053afca</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Demo">f06f80349735ae501c50f91de053afca</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_981ab3f797b9e2101c50f91de053af4a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-05 06:46:36</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
